title: AllinCMS authoritative verification evidence contract
boundary: A passing check records structured evidence supplied by the live handler and bound to the current client task, site, entity and artifact digest. It does not make HTTP 200, a toast, a screenshot, or an author assertion sufficient by itself, and it does not prove SEO, inquiry or conversion.

check_definitions.acceptance: Read back the authoritative same-site discovery result for the approved explore operation; an unauthenticated page, cached assumption or generic HTTP 200 is insufficient.
Without sending a mutation request, read back the authoritative same-site entity and prove the normalized current state requires no change for the approved noop operation.
Read back a non-empty precise taxonomy ID from the authoritative same-site backend record.
Read back the exact slug and every submitted taxonomy field from the authoritative backend record.
Read back the exact selected site binding; another site or an unbound record fails.
Prove the complete same-site taxonomy snapshot contains no second record with the target slug.
Immediately before mutation, the authoritative current fingerprint exactly matches the approved expected-current fingerprint.
Read back every submitted field exactly from the authoritative backend record after persistence.
Read back a non-empty precise media ID from the authoritative same-site media record.
Read back the persisted absolute HTTPS media URL from the authoritative backend record.
Fetch the persisted HTTPS media URL without authenticated state and observe HTTP 200.
Decode the anonymously fetched response as an image; an image MIME header without decode is insufficient.
Read back the exact persisted title, alt, caption and other submitted media metadata.
Read back all submitted article fields, lifecycle state and exact same-site article ID from the authoritative backend record.
Reopen the exact article editor and confirm the editor is healthy and renders the persisted content rather than only returning HTTP 200.
When present, read back exact category, tag, cover and inline-media bindings from the authoritative article record.
Read back the exact article ID in the backend published lifecycle state after the publish transition.
Resolve the exact absolute HTTPS public article URL anonymously and observe HTTP 200.
Load the exact detail URL without authenticated state and confirm the expected article detail page, not a login page, fallback or generic 200 shell.
Confirm the expected buyer-visible article content and required media are present in the anonymous frontend DOM and required images decode.
Read back all submitted product fields, lifecycle state and exact same-site product ID from the authoritative backend record.
Reopen the exact product editor and confirm the editor is healthy and renders persisted fields rather than only HTTP 200.
When present, read back exact category, tag, media and specification bindings from the authoritative product record.
Read back the exact product ID in the backend published lifecycle state after the publish transition.
Resolve the exact absolute HTTPS public product URL anonymously and observe HTTP 200.
Load the exact product detail URL without authenticated state and confirm the expected product detail page, not a login page, fallback or generic 200 shell.
Confirm the expected buyer-visible product content, specifications and required media are present in the anonymous frontend DOM and required images decode.
Prove exactly one new site ID appeared between complete before/after site lists.
Read back the new site owner, generated site key, default domain and setupError from the authoritative account record.
Prove exactly one new post ID appeared between complete before/after post lists of the same site.
Read back all submitted article fields, lifecycle state and the exact same-site post ID from the authoritative backend record.
Reopen the exact article editor (GET update page) and confirm it returns 200 non-sign-in with persisted content rather than only HTTP 200.

artifact_contract.digest_binding: SHA-256 must match the exact primary JSON artifact bytes read from artifact_ref.
artifact_contract.envelope_binding: The parsed primary JSON artifact must exactly match the structured check envelope; screenshots may only be supplementary references inside that artifact and never the primary proof.
artifact_contract.subject_binding: subject_digest must equal the controller-derived digest of the approved operation and desired entity.
artifact_contract.identity_binding: Since contract 1.1 every operation evidence row carries runtime_entity_id plus runtime_entity_id_source (plan_exact_id, execute_result, authoritative_readback or unresolved). readback_passed requires a non-null runtime_entity_id and every structured check's entity_id must equal it; article:create and product:create IDs come from the execute result, and a natural key resolves only after its authoritative readback. 1.0 evidence cannot obtain this identity-bound PASS.
artifact_contract.time_binding: captured_at must be within the operation execution window.
